name: Xerash's Herb Pouch
summary: Xerash's Herb Pouch carries herbs for Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas. He needs them to prepare a muisek vessel.

sections.title: Herbs for Uzer'i
sections.body: Witch Doctor Uzer'i needs Xerash's herbs for a ritual in Feralas. Xerash is satisfied with the shrunken head, and sends the pouch along with word of that approval. Uzer'i applies the herbs as he prepares the muisek vessel, hoping his latest incantations will prove powerful.

faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i needs Xerash's Herb Pouch to prepare a muisek vessel.
The pouch holds herbs Xerash gathered for Witch Doctor Uzer'i.

faq.q: Why does Uzer'i want the herbs?
aliases: what does uzeri need them for
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i applies the herbs while preparing a muisek vessel for a ritual.

faq.q: What does Xerash say about the shrunken head?
faq.answer: Xerash is satisfied with the shrunken head and asks that Witch Doctor Uzer'i be told.
Witch Doctor Uzer'i is preparing a muisek vessel for a ritual involving his latest incantations.
